jobs.title: ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant 2026: 1393 Technical Assistant and Senior Technical Assistant Posts
jobs.summary: The Agricultural Scientists Recruitment Board has notified 1,393 Technical Assistant (T-3) and Senior Technical Assistant (T-4) posts for ICAR institutes and KVKs through the Centralized Combined Examination 2026. Graduates (and diploma holders for workshop groups) in the listed disciplines can apply online by 17 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: Bachelor's degree in the functional group's subject (agriculture & allied, B.V.Sc, B.F.Sc, library science, BCA/B.Sc CS/IT, B.Tech CS/IT/ECE); B.E./B.Tech or 3-year diploma for workshop groups
Age: 21 to 30 years on 17 December 2026; relaxation as per notification
Fee: UR Rs 300 per post (Rs 600 both); EWS/OBC Rs 150 (Rs 300 both); SC/ST/PwBD/Women/Ex-Servicemen nil
Selection: Prelims CBT (qualifying), Mains CBT (merit), document verification; no interview
Dates: apply 18 Nov - 17 Dec 2026; correction 18-20 Dec; Prelims February 2027 (tentative)

jobs.title: Exim Bank Management Trainee 2026: 90 Posts
jobs.summary: Export-Import Bank of India has notified 90 Management Trainee posts for graduates with an MBA/PGDBA/PGDBM/MMS or CA. Online registration runs from 27 November to 11 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: Graduation with 60% plus 2-year full-time MBA/PGDBA/PGDBM/MMS (60%) in Finance, International Business or Foreign Trade, or CA; stream-wise rules as per notification
Age: 21 to 28 years as on 01 November 2026; relaxation as per notification
Pay: Stipend Rs 65,000 per month for 1 year of training, then Deputy Manager (JM-I), scale Rs 48,480-85,920
Fee: General/OBC Rs 600; SC/ST/PwBD/EWS/Women Rs 100
Selection: Subjective written test (70%) and personal interview (30%)
Dates: apply 27 Nov - 11 Dec 2026; written test December 2026 (tentative)

jobs.title: IOCL Eastern Region Apprentice 2026: 409 Posts
jobs.summary: Indian Oil Corporation's Marketing Division, Eastern Region has notified 409 apprentice seats, including graduate apprentice seats for BA, B.Com, B.Sc and BBA graduates. Apply on NATS/NAPS by 12 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: Regular full-time BA/B.Com/B.Sc/BBA with 50% (45% SC/ST/PwBD), passed between 1 April 2023 and 30 November 2026
Age: 18 to 24 years as on 30 November 2026; relaxation as per notification
Stipend: As per Apprentices Act
Selection: Merit on qualifying-exam marks, document verification, medical fitness
Dates: apply 13 Nov - 12 Dec 2026

jobs.title: ISRO SAC Ahmedabad Apprentice 2026: Graduate, Technician and Trade Apprentice
jobs.summary: ISRO's Space Applications Centre, Ahmedabad has notified graduate, technician and trade apprentice positions for 2026-27. Graduates from universities in the listed western states can apply online by 2 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: B.E./B.Tech (ECE, Mechanical, CS/IT, Electrical, Civil, Production) or B.Com/BCA/BA with 60%, passed December 2023 or later, from a university in Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan or DNH&DD
Age: Graduate apprentice 18 to 28 years as on 2 December 2026
Stipend: Graduate apprentice Rs 12,300 per month
Selection: Shortlisting on qualifying-exam marks, document verification
Dates: apply 11 Nov - 2 Dec 2026
